context.content_translation:
通过匿名完成员工满意度调查，工人们可以更……地表达他们对工作场所的担忧。
A. 完全地
B. 公开地
C. 有利地
D. 费力地

items.question: By completing employee-satisfaction surveys anonymously, workers can more ------- state their concerns about the workplace.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“openly”代入题干后为“By completing employee-satisfaction surveys anonymously, workers can more openly state their concerns about the workplace.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（openly）。
